answer.thought: The day’s final transaction is closed, and the bookseller’s dismissal marks the boundary of my time in the market. I am home, in the white cotton, with the air still carrying the faint dust of the road. My body is tired, a stubborn particularity that refuses to be sublated by the spirit, so I must yield to it. I will sit in the dark and let the evening settle.
